basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 18.' and it opens 'Vers. 18. Surge, et tolle puerum, et tene manum ejus. Hoc est junge te illi, et ambula'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 18. Surge, et tolle puerum, et tene manum ejus. Hoc est junge te illi, et ambula cum illo. Sic faciunt ambulantes simul. Juxta litteram intelligimus matrem se abscondisse, quando dixit: Non videbo morientem puerum. Monet ergo eam angelus ut revertatur ad puerum, et tollat eum, non de terra erigendo | vel portando, sed in sua cura et providentia suscipiendo.
